{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["ticnopillahuelilocattin 'let us not be ungrateful' -> 'let us not be wicked'", "otlacauhtzino iyollotzin 'He condescended / humbled His heart' -> 'He gave up His heart'", "quimonopillahueliloque 'they were ungrateful toward Him' -> 'they were wicked toward Him'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["in ic ahmo ... milacatzoz 'so that we too do not turn away (in ingratitude)' -> 'so that the Holy Church does not spin around in ungratefulness'", "techmoyolehuilia (the Church) 'she stirs us' -> 'He urges us'", "icnelilmachoni 'worthy of thanks' -> 'mercy-deserving'", "quimocuitique 'acknowledged' -> 'did not care for'", "quimocnelilmachitique 'gave thanks for' -> 'did not feel the love of God'", "in ic cenca huel tipohpolihuiz 'and so you will be utterly destroyed' -> 'because you will be utterly destroyed'", "tohueytlaocoliloca 'the great mercy shown to us' -> 'our great pity, our great love'"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A is accurate apart from small slips, such as rendering 'ungrateful' as 'wicked', while B gets several things wrong, most seriously making the Church the one that turns away in the Advent passage."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["margin 'Amos. 4.'", "margin 'Como nos emos de aparejar para recebir à Christo' (How we must prepare ourselves to receive Christ)", "the name Amos in the main text (it appears only in a note)", "Spanish gloss '(idem)' after techmonehmachtilia"], "added": ["\"foolish, foolish\" (doubles a word that is not repeated in the source)"], "mistranslated": ["itlatenquixticatzin Dios Amos (God's spokesman Amos) -> \"His messenger God teaches us\"", "tequiyotl tlacoyotl (tribute and servitude) -> \"the hardships and the poverty\"", "in catlehuatl in tetlahpalohuaya yez (what their greeting gift will be) -> \"whoever is to be the one to greet Him\"", "yollotlahueliloque (wicked-hearted) -> \"foolish\"", "çan ilhuice otequicochque (instead they slept soundly) -> \"They only came to sleep in vain\"", "omoxiccauhque (they grew negligent) -> \"they were left behind\"", "ahuaque tepehuaque (townspeople, an idiom) -> \"the inhabitants of the mountains and the plains\""]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": ["\"and celebrated\" (quiça means 'occurs'; this slightly over-renders it)"], "mistranslated": ["molnamiqui ilhuitzin quiça (the feast that is remembered occurs) -> \"is remembered and celebrated\" (minor)"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B is complete and accurate, including the margins, Amos as God's spokesman, tribute and servitude, and the greeting gift, while A drops two margins and misreads several key phrases."}
